name: bosi-programming-skills
description: Bosi's LLM skills: two-axis code review and the code-standards catalog it checks against, change visualization for code and for docs, an output-shape gate for summaries, an epistemic-action gate against predicting instead of checking, a phased recipe workflow from task to merged PR, and a sub-agent relay that runs that recipe hands-off.

interface.shortDescription: Code review, standards, visualization, and a task-to-PR recipe
interface.longDescription: Multi-harness engineering skills. Two-axis code review renders its findings as a page; the code-standards catalog is the baseline it reads; code-visualizer and docs-visualizer turn a diff into a picture; summarize-llm-response and epistemic-action gate the model's own writing and reasoning; bosi-feature-recipe carries a task to a merged pull request in six phases, and recipe-relay runs it hands-off.
defaultPrompt: Visualize what changed in this pull request.
Run the feature recipe on this ticket.
